envelope.name: Dark mode
envelope.request: On the settings page of the habit tracker, add a Dark mode switch. It should remember my choice.

spec.summary: Adds a Dark mode switch to the settings page. The page turns dark when it is on, and the choice is remembered.

features.title: Dark mode switch on the settings page
features.story: As a user I can switch the app to dark colours on the settings page, and it stays that way when I come back.
acceptance: The settings page shows a switch labelled Dark mode, and it is off by default.
Turning the switch on makes the page background dark.
Turning the switch off makes the page background light again.
After the switch is turned on and the page is reloaded, the switch is still on and the page is dark.
After the switch is turned off and the page is reloaded, the switch is off and the page is light.

assumptions: The switch is off until the person turns it on, and the choice is kept for that person on the same device.
spec.uiContract:
- The switch is on the settings page and its label is Dark mode.
- The switch has the test id dark-mode-switch.
